{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for any anomalies in the 'responded' column
# Ensure it only contains 0 and 1
if not set(df['responded'].unique()) == {0, 1}:
    raise ValueError('The responded column contains unexpected values.')

# Check for imbalance in site sizes
site_counts = df['site'].value_counts()
print(f'Site counts:\n{site_counts}')

# Check if sites are comparable in terms of other variables
# Cross-tabulate site vs arm to check for confounding
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])
print(f'\nSite vs arm cross-tab:\n{cross_tab}')

# Check severity distribution across sites
cross_tab_severity = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])
print(f'\nSite vs severity cross-tab:\n{cross_tab_severity}')"}
